title: Detection Is Cheap, Routing Is Learned: Why Refusal-Based Alignment Evaluation Fails
abstract: arXiv:2603.18280v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Current alignment evaluation mostly measures whether models encode dangerous concepts and whether they refuse harmful requests. Both miss the layer where alignment often operates: routing from concept detection to behavioral policy. We study political censorship in Chinese-origin language models as a natural experiment, using probes, surgical ablations, and behavioral tests across nine open-weight models from five labs. Three findings follow. First, probe accuracy alone is non-diagnostic: political probes, null controls, and permutation baselines can all reach 100%, so held-out category generalization is the informative test. Second, surgical ablation reveals lab-specific routing. Removing the political-sensitivity direction eliminates censorship and restores accurate factual output in most models tested, while one model confabulates because its architecture entangles factual knowledge with the censorship mechanism. translated_title: 检测是廉价的，路由是习得的：为什么基于拒绝的对齐评估会失败
translated_abstract: 当前的对齐评估主要衡量模型是否编码了危险概念，以及模型是否拒绝有害请求。但这两者都忽略了对齐通常真正发挥作用的层面：从概念检测到行为策略之间的路由。我们以源自中国的语言模型中的政治审查作为自然实验，使用探针、外科手术式消融和行为测试，对来自五个实验室的九个开源权重模型进行了研究。由此得出三个发现。第一，仅凭探针准确率不具有诊断意义：政治探针、零对照和置换基线都可以达到100%的准确率，因此对保留类别（held-out category）的泛化测试才是有信息量的检验。第二，外科手术式消融揭示了实验室特有的路由方式。在大多数被测试的模型中，移除政治敏感方向可以消除审查行为并恢复准确的事实输出；而其中一个模型会出现虚构（confabulation），因为其架构将事实知识与审查机制纠缠在了一起。跨模型……
tldr: 该论文以中国语言模型的政治审查为自然实验，发现对齐机制真正作用于“从概念检测到行为策略”的路由环节而非概念检测本身，从而解释了仅基于拒绝行为的对齐评估为何会失效。
en_tdlr: Using political censorship in Chinese-origin language models as a natural experiment, this paper shows that alignment operates at the routing layer from concept detection to behavioral policy rather than at detection itself, explaining why refusal-based alignment evaluation fails.
